## KSeF - JPK_VAT Preparation

**Schedule:** 5th of month at 08:00 Warsaw
**Process:** Query clients -> Get invoices -> Assign JPK markers -> CSV + Email -> Audit log

**JPK Markers:** NrKSeF (e-invoice OK), OFF (offline OK), BFK (late upload), DI (manual review)

All DB queries use real Postgres nodes.

## JPK Markers
- **NrKSeF** - Has KSeF number
- **OFF** - Offline, uploaded on time
- **BFK** - Offline, uploaded late (correction needed)
- **DI** - Cannot determine, manual review
